candidates.name: SciPy rectangular linear assignment (modified Jonker-Volgenant)
candidates.conditions: Minimize a finite rectangular cost matrix; each task exactly once, each worker at most once. Workers fewer than tasks means infeasible under this contract.

candidates.name: HiGHS mixed integer linear programming through SciPy
candidates.conditions: Linear objective and constraints, finite input coefficients, integer decisions; binary one-to-one assignment also has this formulation. Infeasibility does not make the method inapplicable.
